headline: Sacyr consortium wins rail concession in high-speed Lisbon-Porto project
summary: Spanish group Sacyr holds 55% of a consortium that won a railway concession for the Oia-Soure section of the Lisbon-Porto high-speed line, involving five and a half years of construction and 24 and a half years of operation.
why: Long-term infrastructure concessions provide construction firms with predictable revenue streams and multi-year order books.

impacts.name: Sacyr
impacts.why: Winning a major infrastructure concession secures future construction revenue and operating cash flows.
